items.item_text: Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a related area.
Advance experience using financial transactions and systems, as well as related policy, accounting, and unique regulatory compliance requirements.

Develops, implements, and/or maintains one or more general accounting policies, procedures, and/or internal processes. Assists with ERP system improvements, system testing, and resolution of accounting-related system errors. Leads the implementation and/or maintenance of the general accounting processes related to the Oracle Cloud financial system and various subledger modules. Understands the accounting behind transactions flowing through the financial system and sub-ledgers, and leads reconciliations of related transactions. Reviews and assists with the analysis/evaluation of the new chart string values and key segments. Provides training and guidance to campus units for transaction processing, reconciliation, and reporting for areas assigned Directly supervises two career employees and exercises independent judgment in personnel-related matters, including hiring recommendations, assigning and reviewing work, conducting performance evaluations, resolving employee concerns, recommending compensation actions, and administering corrective action consistent with University policies and collective bargaining agreements.

Prepares, reviews, and approves journal entries, and maintains and reconciles ledger accounts for assigned areas. Prepares monthly general ledger-to-subledger reconciliations as assigned. Gathers and analyzes specific data in ledger accounts and funds using available reports and, when needed, prepares moderately complex reports by querying available databases.

Provides a record of assets, liabilities, and other financial transactions. Review fund balances, account/fund group summaries, and various standard and ad-hoc reports for prudent fund management. Work with departmental personnel to resolve overdrafts, unallowable expenses, inappropriate recording of activity, and other fund management-related responsibilities for assigned areas. Develop and provide reports for upper management.

Balances books periodically and prepares financial statements. Prepare ledgers for fiscal year-end closing by reviewing and analyzing balances for reporting. Prepare any fiscal year-end transactions required to close the books for assigned areas. Complete appendices, schedules, and reports on financial data as assigned.

Prepares related financial activity for fiscal year-end closing by reviewing and analyzing balances for reporting. Prepares fiscal year-end transactions required for assigned areas. Completes appendices, schedules, and reports on financial data as assigned. Reviews and provides complex policy interpretation and compliance review for GAAP, GASB, FASB,and other appropriated fund accounting principles and pronouncements to campus users. Escalates significant issues to supervisor/director.

Applies advanced accounting principles to perform highly complex technical analysis to understand past performance and determine present and future performance and / or resource allocations. Provides general guidance and support to campus partners related to appropriate accounting principles and policies. Serves as backup for general department training. Provides support with other departmental tasks and duties as assigned.
Advanced degree from an accredited university in a related area. (Preferred)
Understanding of the interrelationship between procedures and desired results.
Advanced knowledge of accounting theory, principles, and related functions.
Ability to extract, compile, and validate accounting information from multiple sources to complete work assignments.
Advanced ability to effectively present complex accounting and finance related information verbally and in writing.
Advanced knowledge of common desktop / web applications.
Advanced knowledge of analytical procedures used in accounting projects of complex scope.
